chapter: Long Branch and the war years
title: Charlie Rouse as a young Ben Webster follower
summary: Rouse played floor shows with Phillips, idolised Ben Webster, played Cottontail, then left for Billy Eckstine.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: What kind of things did that band do? You played floor shows and stuff?
Yeah, we played floor shows. Same thing. Same band. Rouse stayed with me for a while, then he left.
What was Charlie Rouse into at that time?
What was he sounding like? Was he into soloing at that time?
Like Ben Webster. That was his idol, Ben.
Did he give a lot of solos?

Yeah, he played "Cottontail." Then Rouse left -- he left and went with Billy Eckstine. But he couldn't it. He went with Billy, and he couldn't make it -- at that time. So I got another cat, a young cat who was going to Howard, named Jay Peters.
